mathlibEvidence.checkedStatement: For modules over a commutative ring with topological spaces on source and target, closedness of a partial linear map means closedness of its graph in the product topology; the definition does not require that its domain be the whole space.

For a partial linear endomorphism A of a real Banach space, 1 <= M, dense domain, every real lambda > omega in its resolvent set and the bounds ||R(lambda,A)^n|| <= M/(lambda-omega)^n for n >= 1, constructs a StronglyContinuousSemigroup whose generator is A and whose HasGrowthBound is omega M. For a finite-dimensional real inner-product space V with its Borel measurable structure and F on NNReal x V, IsSemigroupGroupPD F, continuity and bounded range imply existence of a representing measure. This checked declaration is the existence half; uniqueness is not claimed on the strength of this declaration alone.
